raw.title: BCA - BBCA Shares Are Officially Traded Under New Price
raw.content: Jakarta, 13 October 2021 – After obtaining approval from Indonesian Stock Exchange regarding stock split schedule, the PT Bank Central Asia Tbk’s shares (IDX: BBCA) are officially traded under the new price today on Wednesday (13/10/2021). The stock split action has been previously approved with 1 : 5 ratio (1 share split into 5 new shares). The nominal price of each BBCA share before stock split amounted to IDR 62.5, while the nominal price of BBCA share after stock split amounted to IDR 12.5. [...] Furthermore, shares with the new nominal price from stock split shall be distributed by PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (“KSEI”) to shareholders on 15 October 2021. The corporate decision to undertake stock split is based on the current development of capital market, especially due to the high interest shown by retail investors, including young investors, to invest in capital market. The corporation hopes that this action will contribute to the development of domestic capital market. [...] In line with the schedule, yesterday (12/10/2021) was the last exchange day for BBCA share to be traded under the old nominal price in regular market and negotiated market. The new nominal price will be traded in regular market and negotiated market today. For your information, the price of BBCA share at the time of this press release is approximately set on IDR 7,320 per share or equal to IDR 36,600 before stock split.
